purpose: Carrier/interconnect between STM32G0B1CBT6 development board and E220-400MBL-01 evaluation board

electrical_contract.radio_spi_policy: E220 pins 9..13 are not connected to the external STM32; test pads only, avoiding contention with the onboard STM8
electrical_contract.bridge_reset: Optional open-drain reset of E220 onboard STM8 through 2N7002; default released

stackup.groundStrategy: solid GND pours on both sides with stitching vias

rf.note: No RF trace is routed on the carrier. Keep copper and carrier material away from the E220 SMA/antenna end and do not obstruct the coax connector.

board.outline: 62 mm x 57 mm carrier inside the remote enclosure; right-front edge has the enclosure/shock-mount clearance profile
board.moduleArrangement: E220 and STM32 long axes parallel and immediately adjacent; E220 antenna end faces the enclosure SMA side
board.mechanicalRule: Socket headers provide electrical alignment only. Four E220 mounting holes and an independent STM32 retainer carry vibration loads.

interfaces.name: 3V3_POWER_IN
interfaces.orientation: locking wire-to-board connector at carrier edge

interfaces.name: E220_UPWARD_HEADERS
interfaces.orientation: bottom-entry female sockets on carrier; carrier above E220 board

interfaces.name: STM32_HEADERS
interfaces.orientation: bottom-entry female sockets on carrier; SWD/USB remain serviceable through cut-out or edge exposure

assembly.moduleSockets: J2-J7 are bottom-side 2.54 mm through-hole female sockets
assembly.mechanicalRetention: module sockets carry electrical insertion only; enclosure carrier plate and retainers carry vibration load
